## What happened

Reference INC-0215 concerns an incident titled “Outreach laptop sync failure” at River Outreach. The incident began on 2024-11-01 and ended on 2024-11-21. During this period, the affected outreach laptop was unable to complete the required synchronisation process.

## Cause

The recorded cause was an Expired device certificate. The certificate issue prevented the laptop from synchronising captures as expected. This notice records the cause associated with the incident and does not indicate any additional cause.

## Effect

The recorded effect was No local ids stored for those captures. As a result, the relevant captures did not have local ids retained on the device. Staff requiring clarification should contact the service desk and quote INC-0215 when making an enquiry.
